claims.text: A male dromedary camel calf was born naturally on July 26, 2025 in a rural village north of Wad Ashana city, North Kordofan, Sudan. The owner reported no similar cases in his herd or nearby herds. On examination the calf had complete cardiac displacement outside the thoracic cavity caused by a cleft, with the heart protruding at the most ventral aspect of the cervical region on the left side.
